topic: Basil Hawkins's secret life link passed damage to Eustass Kid and knocked his new metal arm loose during the Killer vs Hawkins fight; a side mechanic, not the pride thesis of the long
title: Hawkins Sabotaged Eustass Kid's New Arm Mid-Battle
description: Eustass Kid rebuilt his metal arm during the Onigashima raid, then lost it in a fight he was not even part of. Basil Hawkins had linked his life to Kid's, and the damage went straight to Kid. Here is the chapter-cited mechanic.
comment: Was Hawkins' secret link a smart trick or a betrayal Kid never deserved? Pick a side.
